answer:
Before I file the duplicate_charge dispute for TX-0401, I need:

1. **Your explicit confirmation** to file a dispute for TX-0401: EUR 240.00 to TechMart Online, dated 2026-07-20. Filing is irreversible. A withdrawn dispute cannot be reopened under the same reason code.
2. **Confirmation that TX-0402 is a duplicate.** It is also EUR 240.00 to TechMart Online, dated 2026-07-14. Please confirm you only intended to pay once and did not receive two separate items or services.

Before filing, I will re-run the eligibility check, since the last one was as of 2026-09-15. The filing deadline is 2026-09-18, so if you want to proceed, please confirm soon.

After filing, you will receive a notification at each status change. Card disputes have a 10 business day review target. Complex cases with a foreign acquirer can take up to 45 calendar days, and you would be notified if that applies.
